moodrow

components · 0.2.0 · C5 · aj-c-moodrow

The mood row: five word chips, the last row of the form. The ruled form (the writing companion) sets the label in the time column and tints the chosen word in its mood colour.

statedefaultyes: as rendered

statefocus-visibleyes: ruled: as pressed; both: the product focus ring (base)
stateactiveyes: plain: 1px down and .97 under the shell motion; ruled: tone and surface at once
statedisabledn/a: a mood can always be chosen
stateselectedyes: the saved mood, aria-pressed="true": plain filled --rule; ruled underlined in its tone
stateloadingn/a: the choice is saved in the background
stateerrorn/a: the state message under the row says so (legacy .state-message)
stateemptyyes: no mood chosen, all five unpressed
